name: Tetsugoushi no Ouse
source:
―Only five days left until the execution.
When that blade falls...my justice will also be served.

Noel, a girl who lost her family and home to war, finds herself on a aimless journey when she's caught in the rain and takes shelter in a nearby building. Unfortunately, that building turns out to be an old, dilapidated "prison" that has stood since ancient times.

There, Noel meets Diethard, the last death row inmate. Thanks to the chief guard's sympathy, Noel is allowed to stay in the prison for a while and ends up helping to guard the prisoner until the day of the execution, which is just five days away.

Five days spent with a death row inmate… 
Will she send the war criminal to the guillotine with her own hands, or will she find another path? 
The girl's choice will determine the man's fate.

[Taken from [url=http://awoinekura.web.fc2.com/Prison/]the game's homepage[/url]]
translation:
——距离行刑只剩下五天了。
当那把剑落下时……我的正义也将得到伸张。

诺埃尔是一个在战争中失去家人和家园的女孩，当她淋雨并在附近的建筑物避难时，她发现自己陷入了漫无目的的旅程。不幸的是，那栋建筑原来是一座自古以来破旧不堪的“监狱”。

在那里，诺埃尔遇到了最后一名死囚迪特哈德。由于狱长的同情，诺埃尔被允许在监狱里呆一段时间，并最终帮助看守囚犯，直到距离行刑只有五天的日子。

与一名死囚一起度过了五天…… 
她会亲手将战犯送上断头台，还是另辟蹊径？
女孩的选择将决定男人的命运。

[摘自[url=http://awoinekura.web.fc2.com/Prison/]游戏主页[/url]]
